prompt: Style my layer splitting temperature into 6 equal intervals.
criteria: Must use 'equal-intervals' (not 'equal') as the steps.type value
Must be type 'numeric' with numericAttribute set to 'temperature'
Must include paint.color using a numeric sequential palette (`@galaxy`,`@ylRed`,`@ylGrn`,`@purpYl`,`@pinkYl`,`@lightning`,`@copper`,`@spruce`,`@riverine`,`@neptune`,`@violet`,`@purple`)
